title: Digital Safety Lab: UPI Mastery
learningGoals: Explain how UPI connects bank accounts to phone numbers
Identify correct merchant details before payment
Handle a UPI payment simulation correctly

teachingScript.teacherLine: Digital payments are like magic! In India, we use UPI (Unified Payments Interface) to send money instantly. You don't need a wallet, just your phone!

data.title: How UPI Works
points: Link: Your phone number is linked to your many bank accounts.
VPA: You get a unique address like 'name@okpay'.

teachingScript.teacherLine: Let's try the UPI Lab! Try to buy a sketchbook from the 'School Stationery Shop' by scanning their QR code.

questionPool.questionText: Do you need to share your Bank Account Number with someone to receive money via UPI?
questionPool.hint: You only need to share your VPA like 'user@upi'.
